issue.title: SQLAlchemy 2 RC is out. Help by testing on your project!

milestone.title: 2.0 final

issue.body:
Version 2 brings a lot of changes, and it would be very helpful if as many people as possible test the beta to help in fixing issues before the official release.

You can install with `pip install SQLAlchemy==2.0.0rc2`

What's new: https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/20/changelog/whatsnew_20.html
Migration from 1.4: https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/20/changelog/migration_20.html
Changelog: https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/20/changelog/changelog_20.html

issue.body:
### Describe the bug

When using the SQLAlchemy 2 declarative API with models split across multiple files, it seems `import as` is broken.
I use this to `import x as _x` to keep my exports tidy without resorting to defining `__all__`.

### To Reproduce

```python
# See the repo at https://github.com/zacharyrs/sqlalc2-8755
```


### Error

    rval = d[token]
  File "/home/zach/pipeline/env/pyenv/versions/test-db/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sqlalchemy/util/_collections.py", line 347, in __missing__

    return self.fallback[key]
KeyError: 'A_alias'

The above exception was the direct cause of the following exception:
